title: WashU Dance Theatre: ‘right now’ Nov. 6 to 8
summary_en: WashU Dance Theatre will present its 2026 performance, “right now,” Nov. 6-8 in Edison Theatre. The evening-length concert will feature new works by resident and guest choreographers, including visiting artists Shura Baryshnikov and Renée Austin.
title_cn: WashU Dance Theatre: ‘right now’ Nov. 6 to 8

title: Cannabis involved in most substance-related emergency visits among teens, young adults
summary_en: WashU Medicine researchers analyzed emergency department visits and hospitalizations related to substance use nationwide and found diverging age patterns: While alcohol was involved in the majority of visits by older adults, cannabis predominated among young people.
title_cn: Cannabis involved in most substance-related emergency visits among teens, young adults
